prayerExcerpt.en-US: Suddenly a dove flying down lighted on his head.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: De repente, uma pomba desceu voando e pousou sobre sua cabeça.

meta.face: A lean, clean-shaven man of about sixty-five with a long, fine-boned face — a thin nose with a high, narrow bridge and a slight hump, gentle downcast grey-blue eyes with drooping outer lids under fine brows sloping down at the ends, fine cheekbones over hollow cheeks, a long, narrow chin and a small, thin mouth; thick, short silver hair showing below the tiara, and a humble, quiet expression.
meta.basis: Eusebius tells of the dove that settled on his head at his election; Giovanni di Paolo's Saints Fabian and Sebastian (National Gallery, London) paints him as a lean, clean-shaven old pope with a mild, lowered gaze. That keeps him apart from the heavy-set Leo and the bearded Gregory.
meta.excerpt: Eusebius, Church History VI.29.3 (McGiffert tr., NPNF 1890, public domain, en-US verbatim); pt-BR is our faithful rendering

sources.title: Eusebius, Church History VI (New Advent, NPNF)
